title: A line of your own over chords

cues.show: You with the guitar, the solo-over on screen: the neck and the line above it.
cues.say: This one has no part to copy. The chords play, and you make up your own line over them. Nothing is checked.

cues.show: Point at the dots on the neck, then at the ringed ones, then at the line above the neck.
cues.say: The dots on the neck are the notes that fit. They stay the same the whole time.

cues.show: Point at the dots on the neck, then at the ringed ones, then at the line above the neck.
cues.say: The ringed dots are the notes of the chord playing now, and the line above the neck names the note to land on.

cues.show: Press the Play button. Play one long note per chord: the ringed one.
cues.say: Press the Play button below to start the chords.

cues.show: Press the Play button. Play one long note per chord: the ringed one.
cues.say: Begin with one note for each chord: a ringed one. Hold it and listen to how it sits in the chord.

cues.show: Add two or three notes that lead to the ringed note at each change.
cues.say: Now walk to it. Play two or three dots next to the ringed note, and arrive on it as the chord changes.

cues.show: Leave a bar empty, then answer it.
cues.say: Leave gaps. Play a short idea, then stay silent for the same length of time, then answer it.

cues.show: Leave a bar empty, then answer it.
cues.say: Practice until you hear the chord change coming and your finger is already on its way.

cues.show: Try three ideas in turn: one string only, one rhythm repeated, the same idea higher.
cues.say: Try things with it. Make up a line using only one string.

cues.show: Try three ideas in turn: one string only, one rhythm repeated, the same idea higher.
cues.say: Pick one rhythm and keep it for the whole round, changing only the notes.

cues.show: Try three ideas in turn: one string only, one rhythm repeated, the same idea higher.
cues.say: Play an idea, then play the same idea starting from the next ringed note.

cues.show: Try three ideas in turn: one string only, one rhythm repeated, the same idea higher.
cues.say: There is no wrong line here. A note that sounds odd is one fret from a note that fits.
